body:
After restoring a saved revision, running saved checks can produce PASS in Saved checks while Revisions still says UNCHECKED.

Acceptance criteria:
- Restore still creates a recovery checkpoint and starts with unchecked results.
- A successful check does not coexist with an old assertion that results are unchecked.
- Failed checks and settings/definition changes never retain a stale PASS.
- Recovery/guard failures preserve the active project.
- Add a regression that fails on the baseline; verify the normal browser flow.

Keep this to status correctness and its regression, without changing sound or storage semantics.
title: Fix stale revision verification notice
